list.name: asset
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT asset_id AS __text,asset_id AS __value FROM history.scada_10m ORDER BY asset_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(energy_kwh) AS estimated_kwh FROM history.daily_rollup WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND bucket>=(CASE ${window:sqlstring} WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' WHEN 'month' THEN date_trunc('month',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' ELSE '-infinity'::timestamptz END) AND bucket<NOW()

SELECT bucket AS time,energy_kwh FROM history.daily_rollup WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND bucket>=(CASE ${window:sqlstring} WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' WHEN 'month' THEN date_trunc('month',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' ELSE '-infinity'::timestamptz END) AND bucket<NOW() ORDER BY bucket

SELECT bucket AS time,wind_speed_avg,wind_speed_max FROM history.daily_rollup WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND bucket>=(CASE ${window:sqlstring} WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' WHEN 'month' THEN date_trunc('month',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' ELSE '-infinity'::timestamptz END) AND bucket<NOW() ORDER BY bucket

SELECT bucket AS time,active_power_avg,active_power_max FROM history.daily_rollup WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND bucket>=(CASE ${window:sqlstring} WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' WHEN 'month' THEN date_trunc('month',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' ELSE '-infinity'::timestamptz END) AND bucket<NOW() ORDER BY bucket

SELECT bucket AS time,coverage_pct,partial_count FROM history.daily_rollup WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND bucket>=(CASE ${window:sqlstring} WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' WHEN 'month' THEN date_trunc('month',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' ELSE '-infinity'::timestamptz END) AND bucket<NOW() ORDER BY bucket
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()-MAX(observed_at_utc)) AS age_seconds FROM history.scada_10m WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring}

SELECT source,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM history.scada_10m WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND observed_at_utc>=(CASE ${window:sqlstring} WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' WHEN 'month' THEN date_trunc('month',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' ELSE '-infinity'::timestamptz END) GROUP BY source

panels.title: Last API sync and monthly report

options.content: Energy is estimated from ten-minute mean net power. All time means stored observations, not lifetime since commissioning. Missing days are absent, never zero-filled. Today has partial full-day coverage. Failure details: /api/history/health. Sync/import outcomes are mirrored into the table comment; database-down failures remain visible through app health.
